paper_title: Search for oscillations of fundamental constants using molecular spectroscopy
notes: Paper constrains oscillating UDM coupling to quarks/gluons (QCD sector) via molecular iodine spectroscopy; primary plot (Fig.3) shows combination Q_N·d = 0.999 d_gs + 0.092 d_mhat + ... vs Compton frequency (10 Hz-100 MHz, i.e. ~4e-14 to ~4e-7 eV). This maps best to ScalarNucleon. Multiple couplings (d_alpha, d_me in Fig.4) also constrained, so coupling type assignment is somewhat ambiguous. No numerical data table provided; limits only shown graphically, so no reliable (mass,coupling) points extractable. DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 (galactic halo standard scenario; also discusses solar/earth halo enhancements). 95% CL stated. | Vision: This plot is for d_me (ScalarElectron), not ScalarNucleon as hinted. The lowest exclusion boundary in the relevant frequency range is set by the Microscope/Be-Al EP test solid lines. I traced the Be-Al solid line which appears to give the lowest envelope across most of the range; below ~3e-12 eV the Microscope line is lower. Values are approximate readings from the log-log plot. | Calibration: No calibration needed
